objective: Publish the approved VisePanda English-first digital visual identity system for international visitors travelling in China to the owner-authorized GitHub repository.
acceptedIssue: Owner request in this task: derive a full VisePanda travel-AI VI system from the supplied logo, then publish the committed delivery to https://github.com/JTCAO515/VP-V4.
scope: SVG icon, map-pin, pattern and UI reference assets
antiGoals: Do not modify the owner-supplied source artwork under assets/brand/vise-panda/.
Do not claim official government, transport, visa, emergency or booking authority.
Do not publish any unrelated untracked workspace content.

activeWork.description: Add the owner-authorized GitHub remote and push master.

assumptions: The specified GitHub repository is owned or writable by the signed-in Git credential.
The digital-first HTML handbook is the accepted manual format; no print/PDF proof was requested.
English is the primary external language, with accurate Chinese place names allowed only in travel context.
decisions: Visual direction: a warm local friend in China, retaining the supplied panda mascot, cream sticker edge and plum/gold/cream/ink palette.
Original supplied logo assets remain immutable; all derived outputs are contained in brand/.
The current branch is master and the delivery history is 58bdc8d, 2f4f91e and d02eb46.

verification.command: PowerShell release verification: JSON parse, 8 IP RGBA/alpha checks, five social dimensions, SVG XML/symbols, handbook section IDs, source integrity and git diff --check
Visual inspection of brand/social/beijing-48-hours-1080.png and brand/ip/welcome.png + brand/ip/rest.png
verification.summary: Approved palette, sticker edge, English display copy and genuine transparent edges observed.

unrunChecks: Native Instagram, TikTok and external-browser publishing previews.
Commercial font licensing and print/PDF proofing.
residualRisk: Social platforms may add compression or overlays; review their platform previews before publishing campaigns.
Campaign travel facts and Chinese-language content require separate, destination-specific fact checking.
GitHub push will depend on local credential access to the owner-authorized remote.

deviation.reason: A scoped, reversible documentation and asset delivery with no source-artwork or product-interface change.

nextAction.description: Push current master, containing the approved VI delivery, to the owner-authorized GitHub remote.
nextAction.expectedObservation: origin/master receives commit d02eb46 and GitHub accepts the push.

rollback: If publication must be reverted, create and push a new revert commit for d02eb46, 2f4f91e and 58bdc8d; do not rewrite shared history. For local asset-only rollback, remove brand/ while retaining the immutable source assets.
